annotation.bound_parties_text: The regulations bind persons operating UAS in Rwanda, including UAS operators, remote pilots, chief remote pilots, UA owners, manufacturers, and approved UAS training organisations.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: Every person lawfully entitled to the possession of a UA who will operate a UA in Rwanda shall register that UA and hold a valid certificate of registration
annotation.dates_quote: the Director General hereby establishes Special Regulations No. RSR/01/2026 of 15 February 2026
annotation.robot_provision_quote: This Part prescribes rules governing the operation of basic and specific unmanned aircraft system (UAS) in the Republic of Rwanda.
